name: collapsible
description: Native guidance for a single expandable region with the default DisclosureGroup, distinct from the styled accordion.
docs: One expandable region is the default `DisclosureGroup`. Use the `accordion` item only when several groups stack as a list. A single collapsible region needs no extra treatment.
accessibility: The native disclosure announces expanded and collapsed states.
Keep the label meaningful when collapsed, because that is all VoiceOver reads.
